meanings.tr: evde kalan, dışarı çıkmayı sevmeyen; (ebeveyn için) evde çocuk büyüten
meanings.en: remaining at home rather than going out to work or socialize
meanings.exampleEn: She became a stay-at-home mother after her second child was born.
meanings.exampleTr: İkinci çocuğu doğduktan sonra evde çocuk büyüten bir anne oldu.

meanings.en: the quality of being diverse or made up of different kinds
meanings.exampleEn: The heterogeneity of the population makes generalizations difficult.
meanings.exampleTr: Nüfusun türdeşsizliği genellemeleri zorlaştırıyor.

meanings.tr: vandal, kasten mülke zarar veren kişi
meanings.en: a person who deliberately destroys or damages property
meanings.exampleEn: Vandals had smashed the windows of the abandoned school.
meanings.exampleTr: Vandallar terk edilmiş okulun camlarını kırmıştı.

meanings.tr: kanepe (üzerine yiyecek konan küçük kraker/ekmek dilimi, ordövr)
meanings.en: a small piece of bread or cracker with a savory topping, served as an appetizer
meanings.exampleEn: Waiters passed around trays of canapés at the reception.
meanings.exampleTr: Garsonlar resepsiyonda kanepe tepsilerini dolaştırdı.

meanings.en: the state of being slightly wet
meanings.exampleEn: The dampness of the cellar had ruined the old books.
meanings.exampleTr: Bodrumun nemi eski kitapları mahvetmişti.

meanings.en: insincere or deceitful, saying different things to different people
meanings.exampleEn: I can't trust him; he's too two-faced.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona güvenemem; fazla iki yüzlü.

meanings.tr: soğuk bir tavırla, buz gibi, mesafeli biçimde
meanings.en: in an unfriendly or cold manner
meanings.exampleEn: "I'd rather not discuss it," she said frostily.
meanings.exampleTr: "Bunu konuşmamayı tercih ederim," dedi soğuk bir tavırla.

meanings.en: a person who has impractical ideas or plans; someone not realistic
meanings.exampleEn: He's a dreamer who thinks he'll be famous someday.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir gün ünlü olacağını düşünen bir hayalperest.

meanings.en: a person who accepts and deals with things as they really are
meanings.exampleEn: As a realist, she knew the project would take years, not months.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir gerçekçi olarak projenin aylar değil yıllar süreceğini biliyordu.

meanings.en: a person who deals with problems in a practical rather than idealistic way
meanings.exampleEn: The manager is a pragmatist who focuses on results, not theories.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetici, teorilere değil sonuçlara odaklanan bir pragmatisttir.

meanings.en: in a slow, relaxed, or idle manner
meanings.exampleEn: The cat stretched lazily in the afternoon sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi öğleden sonra güneşinde tembelce gerindi.

meanings.en: in an active and busy way
meanings.exampleEn: The staff were busily preparing for the conference.
meanings.exampleTr: Personel konferans için telaşla hazırlık yapıyordu.

meanings.tr: zamanlaması iyi, tam yerinde, isabetli zamanlı
meanings.en: done or happening at exactly the right moment
meanings.exampleEn: His well-timed joke eased the tension in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Zamanlaması iyi şakası odadaki gerginliği azalttı.

meanings.tr: okuryazarlık; belli bir konuda bilgi sahibi olma
meanings.en: the ability to read and write; competence in a particular area
meanings.exampleEn: The government launched a campaign to improve adult literacy.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet yetişkin okuryazarlığını artırmak için bir kampanya başlattı.

meanings.en: able to read and write; knowledgeable in a particular field
meanings.exampleEn: Most of the population is now literate.
meanings.exampleTr: Nüfusun çoğu artık okuryazar.

meanings.tr: maddi olma durumu; önemlilik (muhasebede bir bilginin önem derecesi)
meanings.en: the quality of being material; (in accounting) the significance of an item to financial decisions
meanings.exampleEn: Auditors assess the materiality of each error before reporting it.
meanings.exampleTr: Denetçiler her hatayı raporlamadan önce önemliliğini değerlendirir.

meanings.en: the state of not supporting either side in a conflict or disagreement
meanings.exampleEn: Switzerland is famous for its long-standing neutrality.
meanings.exampleTr: İsviçre uzun süredir devam eden tarafsızlığıyla ünlüdür.

meanings.en: the quality of being based on facts rather than personal feelings
meanings.exampleEn: A journalist must maintain objectivity when reporting the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir gazeteci haber verirken nesnelliğini korumalıdır.

meanings.tr: acıya ve zorluğa şikayet etmeden katlanan, metin, stoik
meanings.en: enduring pain or hardship without showing feelings or complaining
meanings.exampleEn: She remained stoic throughout the painful treatment.
meanings.exampleTr: Acılı tedavi boyunca metin kaldı.

meanings.en: not showing or feeling any emotion
meanings.exampleEn: His face stayed emotionless as the verdict was read.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar okunurken yüzü duygusuz kaldı.

meanings.en: not affected or influenced by something; not allowing liquid to pass through
meanings.exampleEn: He seemed impervious to criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştiriden etkilenmez görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not letting water or other fluid pass through
meanings.exampleEn: The coating makes the fabric impervious to rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaplama, kumaşı yağmura karşı geçirimsiz yapar.

meanings.en: the quality of seeming reasonable or probable
meanings.exampleEn: The plausibility of his excuse convinced the teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Mazeretinin inandırıcılığı öğretmeni ikna etti.

meanings.en: to an extraordinary or extreme degree
meanings.exampleEn: The view from the summit was unbelievably beautiful.
meanings.exampleTr: Zirveden görülen manzara inanılmaz derecede güzeldi.

meanings.en: in a way that seems reasonable or believable
meanings.exampleEn: She argued plausibly that the delay was unavoidable.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikmenin kaçınılmaz olduğunu inandırıcı biçimde savundu.

meanings.en: the state of being impossible or impractical to do
meanings.exampleEn: The study demonstrated the infeasibility of the proposed timeline.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışma, önerilen takvimin uygulanamazlığını ortaya koydu.

meanings.en: long and careful consideration or discussion
meanings.exampleEn: After hours of deliberation, the jury reached a verdict.
meanings.exampleTr: Saatlerce süren müzakerenin ardından jüri bir karara vardı.

meanings.en: the quality of being slow and careful in action
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with deliberation, choosing each word carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Her kelimeyi dikkatle seçerek ölçülü biçimde konuştu.

meanings.en: the state of not being enough in amount or quality
meanings.exampleEn: An insufficiency of funds forced the project to close.
meanings.exampleTr: Fon yetersizliği projenin kapanmasına yol açtı.

meanings.en: a fault or failure to reach a particular standard
meanings.exampleEn: The report points out several shortcomings in the current system.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, mevcut sistemdeki birçok eksikliğe işaret ediyor.

meanings.en: the state of being good enough or sufficient in quantity
meanings.exampleEn: They questioned the adequacy of the safety measures.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvenlik önlemlerinin yeterliliğini sorguladılar.

meanings.en: an adequate amount of something; the state of being enough
meanings.exampleEn: The region achieved self-sufficiency in food production.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölge gıda üretiminde kendine yeterliliğe ulaştı.

meanings.en: unwise or imprudent; not sensible
meanings.exampleEn: It would be ill-advised to invest all your savings in one company.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm birikiminizi tek bir şirkete yatırmak tedbirsizce olur.

meanings.tr: dili tutulma, söyleyecek söz bulamama hali
meanings.en: the state of being unable to speak, often from shock or strong emotion
meanings.exampleEn: The news left her in a state of speechlessness.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber onu dili tutulmuş bir halde bıraktı.

meanings.en: made weak or feeble, especially by illness
meanings.exampleEn: He was left debilitated after months of illness.
meanings.exampleTr: Aylarca süren hastalıktan sonra güçten düşmüş halde kaldı.

meanings.en: to cause something to happen or begin, especially something bad
meanings.exampleEn: He was accused of instigating the riot.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayaklanmayı kışkırtmakla suçlandı.

meanings.en: lasting for an unknown or unlimited length of time; not clearly defined
meanings.exampleEn: The factory was closed for an indefinite period.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika belirsiz bir süreyle kapatıldı.

meanings.en: not yet solved, settled, or decided
meanings.exampleEn: The dispute remains unresolved after months of talks.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmazlık aylarca süren görüşmelerden sonra hâlâ çözülmemiş durumda.

meanings.en: not easily seen or noticed
meanings.exampleEn: The repair was almost unnoticeable once the paint dried.
meanings.exampleTr: Boya kuruduktan sonra tamir neredeyse fark edilmez oldu.

meanings.en: not conspicuous or attracting attention
meanings.exampleEn: The security guards were discreet and unobtrusive.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvenlik görevlileri sağduyulu ve göze batmayan biçimdeydi.

meanings.en: clearly visible or attracting attention
meanings.exampleEn: Her bright red coat made her conspicuous in the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Parlak kırmızı montu onu kalabalıkta göze çarpar kıldı.

meanings.en: the quality of changing frequently in loyalty, opinion, or affection
meanings.exampleEn: The fickleness of public opinion makes campaigns hard to plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamuoyunun kararsızlığı kampanyaları planlamayı zorlaştırır.

meanings.en: the fact of being disloyal, especially to a partner
meanings.exampleEn: His unfaithfulness eventually destroyed the marriage.
meanings.exampleTr: Sadakatsizliği sonunda evliliği yıktı.

meanings.en: a tendency to be too ready to believe things
meanings.exampleEn: The scam relied on the credulity of elderly victims.
meanings.exampleTr: Dolandırıcılık, yaşlı kurbanların saflığına dayanıyordu.

meanings.en: proceeding gradually and carefully through each stage
meanings.exampleEn: The manual gives step-by-step instructions for assembly.
meanings.exampleTr: Kılavuz, montaj için adım adım talimatlar veriyor.

meanings.en: a formal charge or accusation of a serious crime
meanings.exampleEn: The grand jury issued an indictment against the former official.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük jüri eski yetkili hakkında bir iddianame düzenledi.

meanings.tr: eleştiri, bir şeyin kötü olduğunun kanıtı
meanings.en: a sign that a system or situation is bad and deserves to be criticized
meanings.exampleEn: The rising poverty rate is a damning indictment of government policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Artan yoksulluk oranı hükümet politikasının ağır bir eleştirisidir.

meanings.en: a feeling of reluctance or unwillingness to do something
meanings.exampleEn: There is growing hesitancy about investing in the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgeye yatırım yapma konusunda artan bir tereddüt var.
